core_principle: HTF direction -> ITF range/key level/manipulation -> LTF change in order flow/entry

project_baseline_alignment.note: Project-specific frozen swing implementation. Keep separate from the creator's broader public timeframe-sequence examples.

creator_public_timeframe_sequence.note: Public Dealing Range / Order Block guidance: use HTF for range/key level and LTF for profiling/entry confirmation; the first LTF listed is the main sequence and the second may be used to scale lower.

bias.bullish_continuation: HTF close above prior high while next key level remains unreached; draw above current high
bias.bearish_continuation: mirror: HTF close below prior low while next key level remains unreached; draw below current low
bias.bearish_reversal: sweep/wick above prior high then close back below/inside; draw toward lower liquidity
bias.bullish_reversal: mirror after sweep below prior low and close back inside

range.dealing_range_public_definition: A dealing range forms when price takes both a swing high and a swing low, followed by a clear expansion move; that expansion swing becomes the dealing range.
range.bearish_manipulation: liquidity sweep above range high into a key level followed by rejection
range.bearish_invalidation: same-ITF candle close above range / failure to close back inside after manipulation
range.bullish_manipulation: liquidity sweep below range low into a key level followed by rejection
range.bullish_invalidation: same-ITF candle close below range / failure to close back inside after manipulation

premium_discount.public_filter: Do not enter from the wrong half of the dealing range merely because a key level exists.

key_levels.public_ob_definition: Last bullish or bearish candle before a strong market move; used either as HTF key level or LTF entry confirmation.
key_levels.entry_confirmation_close: For LTF OB confirmation, wait until candles close above/below the last opposing candle or consecutive opposing candles.

model1.type: liquidity sweep -> rejection -> close back inside range -> change in order flow -> reversal/distribution
required_components_public: strong key level around/outside the range
close back inside the range after manipulation
valid lower-timeframe order block / change in order flow
model1.session_pattern_public_example: Asia accumulation can precede London manipulation; entry comes after proof the raid is finished, not during the raid.
model1.entry: after confirmation candle closes; never before close

model2.precondition: Model 1/first expansion has played out and HTF bias remains valid
model2.target: full CLS range / opposite range side
public_ambiguities: whether LTF CIOD is mandatory in every Model 2 variant
model2.separation_rule: Do not mix Model 2 logic into B1_DAVE_PUBLIC_SWING_M1.

divergence_confirmation.scope: EURUSD + GBPUSD correlated-pair confirmation for the 250-trade research sprint
validity: The two correlated pairs disagree at a comparable swing high or low
One pair takes liquidity while the other does not confirm
The event occurs at a pre-marked location, not a hindsight level
Divergence confirms the idea; Model 1 supplies the trade structure
divergence_confirmation.hard_rule: Divergence is confirmation only. No manipulation and no valid Model 1 means no trade.
research_integrity: Stop, target, and entry-pair rules remain fixed throughout the sample
Historical periods are consecutive or selected before testing
Do not count divergence without Model 1 confirmation as a trade

session_notes.asia: Treat Asia primarily as setup/accumulation context; do not enter the liquidity raid itself.
session_notes.london_continuation: If Asia already manipulated into a key level and displaced with CIOD/OB before London, London can retrace into a premium/discount LTF key level and continue.
session_notes.london_reversal: If Asia consolidates near an HTF key level, London can raid Asia liquidity into that level; require M15 order-flow change/OB before entry.
public_high_probability_filters: recent reaction from Daily/H4 key level
visually consolidating Asia range smaller than about 40 pips
public_low_probability_filters: avoid longs after 3 consecutive bullish daily candles
avoid shorts after 3 consecutive bearish daily candles
avoid immediately ahead of NFP or CPI
avoid Asia range trending or larger than about 40 pips
avoid when Asia is not visually consolidating
avoid absence of a usable candle range

recent_public_example.label: Daily / Weekly CLS - Model 1
recent_public_example.source_support: User-provided CLS Lab before/after screenshots show a Long Model 1 thesis around Weekly/Daily CLS context followed by bullish expansion.
recent_public_example.rule_confirmation: Supports manipulation/key-level -> order-flow-change -> Model 1 sequence. SMT is treated as confirmation, not as standalone entry logic.
